title: Nuru model settings, version 1 (TODO F22)
description: Local administration of a local model family's settings: /v1/models/settings (GET ?model=, PUT, DELETE ?model=&expected_revision=) and /v1/models (POST). Only for a client signed in on this computer's own listener: the remote listener refuses them all. Errors are protocol v1's error body.

custom.description: The user's settings apply, not Nuru's

revision.description: What is saved, shared by every Nuru on this computer

active_revision.description: What this service runs with: a different one applies when it restarts

header.description: The saved header, else Nuru's; null if the family has neither

nuru.description: Nuru's own settings for the family, or null if it has none

default.description: The family of the model new conversations start on

added.description: POST /v1/models only: whether it set the family up
